blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving relies heavily on large annotated datasets, and deploying such a system to a new target region typically requires data collection and annotation.
Generative augmentation has been proposed to reduce this cost, but existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: label-conditioned methods consume the very annotations they aim to replace, while simulator-conditioned methods offer free annotations but lack visual grounding to specific real environments.
This work investigates the extent to which a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline (DT-R2S2R) can substitute for target-region real data.
By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R).
As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage.
The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training.
Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle.
Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception.
Comprehensive details are available at https://anonymouspaperdtr2s2r.netlify.app .
blocks.zh:
基于相机的自发驾驶3D感知很大程度上依赖于有注释的大型数据集,将这种系统部署到一个新的目标区域通常需要数据收集和注释.
为了降低这一成本,有人提议进行基因增强,但现有方法面临一个根本的取舍:标签附加条件的方法消耗它们旨在取而代之的说明,而模拟附加条件的方法则提供免费说明,但缺乏对具体真实环境的视觉基础。
这项工作调查了由数字双向驱动的Real2Sim2Real管线(DT-R2S2R)能够替代目标区域真实数据的程度.
通过在地理参照数字双(DT-R2S)内部重建有记录的驱动剪辑,我们以几何对齐的模拟器渲染为扩散模型的条件,建立数字双地Sim2Real模型(DT-S2R).
因此,DT-S2R在数字双倍覆盖范围内,将摄影现实主义驱动图像合成了跨重构和新作模拟场景的低成本而地理参照的模拟数据。

此外,与现有目标外实际数据进行简单的联合培训,其业绩超过了甲骨文。
因此,DT-R2S2R可以大幅降低在数字双能区进行人工现场数据收集和注释的成本,为提升三维感知提供了实用的基础.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of DT-R2S2R. Sim2Real model is trained on real driving images and reconstruction counterparts. Then the model uses newly synthesized simulator data to produce photorealistic images for training 3D detectors.
blocks.zh: 图1:DT-R2S2R概览. Sim2Real模型在真实的驱动图像和相机重建方面接受了培训. 然后该模型使用新合成的模拟器数据来生成光现实化图像来训练3D探测器.

blocks.en:
Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving is trained on large annotated datasets [ 1 , 2 ] . Despite the considerable labeling cost, it is likely to recur whenever the system needs to be deployed to an unexplored region, given that road geometry, traffic composition, vehicle fleets, and roadside architecture can all differ.
The bottleneck is thus not only the total volume of data but its regional specificity, implying that what is scarce is not driving data in general, but driving data from the region of interest.
blocks.zh:
自动驾驶的相机3D感知器在大注释数据集[1,2]上进行了训练. 尽管贴上标签的费用相当高,但只要系统需要部署到一个未探索的区域,就可能再次发生,因为道路几何、交通组成、车队和路边建筑都可能有所不同。
因此,瓶颈不仅在于数据总量,而且在于其区域特点,这意味着稀缺的不是一般数据驱动,而是来自有关区域的驱动数据。

blocks.en:
Generative data augmentation has been proposed to relieve this cost.
One family conditions a diffusion model on the annotations of a real recording —BEV semantic map, 3D bounding boxes, and camera poses— and pairs each synthesized image with the annotation that produced it [ 3 , 4 ] .
Because the generated frames inherit the geometry of an actual location, they transfer well to that location.
Generating scenes beyond the annotated set, however, requires either further manual labeling or a separate tool to produce layouts.
blocks.zh:
已提议增加遗传数据,以减轻这一费用。
一个家族在真实录制的注释上附加了一个传播模型——BEV语义图,3D边框和相机相机相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片相片
由于生成的相框继承了实际位置的几何,因此它们能很好地转移到该位置.
然而,在附加说明的集之外产生场景,需要更多的人工标签或单独的工具来制作布局.

blocks.en:
Driving simulators are an attractive source for these annotations.
The expensive labels that such generators require —semantic, depth maps, and 3D bounding boxes— are either native or easily producible outputs of the renderer and can be exported for any simulated scene at negligible marginal cost.
This motivates closing the loop: reproducing a real driving scene in a simulator (Real2Sim), exporting the conditions from that reconstruction, and generating photorealistic frames from them (Sim2Real).
Several recent Real2Sim2Real pipelines [ 5 , 6 ] follow this pattern.
blocks.zh:
驱动模拟器是这些说明的有吸引力的来源.
这种发电机需要的昂贵标签——语义图、深度图和三维边框——要么是渲染器的原生产出,要么是易于生产的出产,可以以可忽略不计的边际成本输出给任何模拟场景。
这激励了关闭循环:在模拟器(Real2Sim)中再现出真实的驱动场景,从重建中导出条件,并从中生成光现实相框(Sim2Real).
最近几条Real2Sim2 Real管道[5,6]也遵循了这一模式.

blocks.en:
However, in these systems, the reconstruction usually covers only the placement of dynamic objects and a coarse road layout.
The static surroundings of the location, such as building geometries and roadside structures, have no counterpart in the simulated scene and are left for the Sim2Real generator to synthesize without grounding.
To address this, we construct D igital- T win-driven R eal 2S im 2R eal ( DT-R2S2R ) pipeline, where the road network, buildings, terrain, and vehicle assets are modeled based on the real world rather than arbitrarily synthesized [ 7 , 8 ] .
Our pipeline consists of two modules, DT-R2S and DT-S2R.
First, DT-R2S locates a real driving clip inside the digital twin by matching its GNSS trace against twin maps, replaces each annotated vehicle with the library asset closest in dimension and appearance, and estimates the sensor pose aligning the reconstructed scene with the original recording.
Through the scene rendering, we obtain synthetic RGB images geometrically paired with real counterparts and their low-cost annotations from the simulator.
DT-S2R then takes them as input to condition a diffusion backbone, yielding photorealistic and geospatially grounded images.
Importantly, producing additional virtual driving clips within the simulator and passing them to trained DT-S2R enables the large-scale synthesis of high-fidelity and georeferenced data for the specific target regions at marginal cost, as shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh:
然而,在这些系统中,重建通常只包括动态物体的布局和粗糙的道路布局.
位置的静态周围,如建造地平面和路边结构,在模拟场景中没有对应物,被留给Sim2Real发电机进行合成而无地平面.
为了解决这个问题,我们建造了Digital-T win-驱动的 R eal 2S im 2R eal (DT-R2S2R)管线,其中的道路网络、建筑物、地形和车辆资产都是以真实世界为基础而不是任意合成的[7,8]。
我们的管道包括两个模块,DT-R2S和DT-S2R。
首先,DT-R2S通过将其GNSS的踪迹与双子地图相匹配,在数字双子内部定位出一个真实的驱动剪辑,用最接近尺寸和外观的图书库资产来替换每个被附加注释的载体,并估计传感器将重构的场景与原作的录音相配合.
通过场景渲染,我们从模拟器那里获得合成的RGB图像与真实对等的相机和它们的低成本说明相配几何.
DT-S2R然后将它们作为输入,以建立传播的主干线,产生光现实性和地理空间基础图像。
重要的是,如图1所示,在模拟器内制作更多的虚拟驱动剪辑并将其传递给训练有素的DT-S2R,能够以边际成本大规模合成特定目标区域的高真实性和地理参考数据。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are twofold. • We construct DT-R2S2R that couples geometrically paired driving-scene reconstruction (DT-R2S) with a spatially-consistent image translation (DT-S2R). • We comprehensively validate our pipeline not only as a high-fidelity image generator but also as a labeled-data engine for 3D detection training across diverse settings.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献有两方面。 我们构建了DT-R2S2R,夫妇几何对接的驱动-场景重建(DT-R2S),并配有符合空间的图像翻译(DT-S2R). 二. 支助 我们全面验证我们的管道,不仅作为高真实度图像生成器,而且作为标有标签的数据引擎,用于不同场合的3D检测培训。

blocks.en: II-A Synthetic Driving Data
blocks.zh: II-A 合成驱动数据

blocks.en:
Game engines and driving simulators make it affordable to produce large, labeled driving datasets, but in many cases, these datasets lack real-world counterparts.
Several datasets have addressed this by introducing direct references to real datasets to narrow the gap. For example, nuCarla [ 9 ] mirrors the sensor layout and data format of nuScenes [ 1 ] .
Closer correspondence has been obtained by reconstructing the recordings. DIVA-Sim [ 5 ] rebuilds nuScenes clips in a simulator, recovering the road network and replaying the logged object trajectories.
VKITTI [ 10 ] goes further for KITTI [ 2 ] , also reproducing background structures such as buildings and trees.
Following this line, we perform Real2Sim inside a digital twin built from the HD map of the target region, where the road network, buildings, and terrain are already available at high fidelity, so that any clip recorded within the covered area can be paired with a geometrically aligned rendering.
blocks.zh:
游戏引擎和驱动模拟器使得制作大型,标有标签的驱动数据集能够负担得起,但在许多情况下,这些数据集缺乏现实世界的对应数据.
几个数据集通过直接引用实际数据集来缩小差距来解决这个问题。 例如:nuCarla [9] 反射出nuScenes [1] 的传感器布局和数据格式.
通过重新制作录音,获得了更密切的通信。 DIVA-Sim [5]在模拟器中重建了nuScens片段,恢复了路网并重放被登录的对象轨迹.
VKITTI [10] 更进一步为KITTI [2],也再现了建筑和树木等背景结构.
沿着这条线,我们执行Real2Sim,在从目标区域的HD地图上所建的数字双胞胎,其中公路网,建筑物,地势已经高度忠实,因此所覆盖区域内所记录的任何片段都可以被配对出几何对称的渲染.

blocks.en: II-B Photorealistic Image Generation
blocks.zh: II-B 相片真实图像生成

blocks.en:
The transformation of a rendered synthetic image into a realistic one has traditionally been posed as an unpaired image-to-image translation, as paired real-synthetic image sets are often not available. The characteristic limitation of those approaches is semantic flipping [ 11 ] .
To overcome this limitation, FDA [ 12 ] swaps the low-frequency amplitude of source and target images, which does not require training and retains the source contents. An adversarial learning-based method VSAIT [ 11 ] , on the other hand, addresses this by learning the mapping in a high-dimensional vector space, where source-related information, such as texture and color, is unbound and target-related information is bound in its place. SODA-CAM [ 13 ] adapts the formulation to multimodal driving data.
blocks.zh:
将制成的合成相片转化为现实相片,传统上一直被作为未发作的相片到相片翻译来呈现,因为成对的真相片集往往不可用. 这些方法的特点限制是语义翻转[11]。
为了克服这一限制,FDA[12]互换了源和目标图像的低频振幅,这不需要培训,保留了源内容. 另一方面,一种基于对抗性的学习方法VSAIT [11]通过在高维向量空间中学习映射来解决这个问题,其中与源相关的信息,如纹理和颜色,是不受约束的,与目标相关的信息被约束在它的位置上. SODA-CAM [13] 使配方适应了多式驱动数据.

blocks.en:
Another common choice for the same task is latent diffusion models (LDMs), such as SDXL [ 14 ] , with auxiliary networks which supply conditions.
For instance, ControlNet [ 15 ] copies the down and middle blocks of the backbone, processes the given condition, and injects their output back to the backbone.
T2I-Adapter [ 16 ] replaces the copy with a small feature extractor. SDEdit [ 17 ] , on the other hand, uses the noise-added condition as a starting point for the denoising process.
Extending this direction, conditional diffusion models are also widely used to generate driving data directly from annotations. MagicDrive [ 3 ] , SimGen [ 5 ] , and InstaDrive [ 4 ] are recent examples where labels of a real recording are consumed as conditions so that the generated frames are paired with those.
blocks.zh:
同一任务的另一个共同选择是潜在的扩散模型,如SDXL[14],其辅助网络提供条件。
例如,ControlNet[15]复制了主干线的下行和中行块,处理给定条件,并将输出回注入主干线.
T2I-Adapter [16] 将副本替换为小特性提取器. SDEDit [17] 另一方面,使用加噪条件作为去诺过程的起点.
扩展这个方向,有条件的传播模型也被广泛用于直接从注释生成驱动数据. 魔法驱动 [3],SimGen [5],和InstaDrive [4]是最近一些实例,其中真实录音的标签被消耗为条件,以便生成的相框与这些相配.

blocks.en:
Across the mentioned methods, the output is limited by how much of the real scene the condition describes: a projected box or a semantic map states where an object is, not what it or its surroundings look like. Hence, a generator can only imagine the appearance of the surrounding structure, which often induces semantic flipping.
We therefore use a rendering from the digital twin as a strong anchor for a paired Sim2Real translation, facilitating the preservation of critical static structures.
blocks.zh:
在整个上述方法中,输出受到条件描述的真实场景的多少限制:一个投影盒或一个语义地图表示一个物体是在哪里,而不是它或周围的外观. 因此,一个生成器只能想象周围结构的外观,这常常会诱发语义翻转.
因此,我们利用数码双胞胎的渲染作为一对Sim2Real翻译的坚固锚地,促进保存关键的静态结构。

blocks.en: III-A DT-R2S: Paired Driving-Scene Reconstruction
blocks.zh: III-A DT-R2S: 和平驾驶-场地重建

blocks.en:
To generate scene-level geometrically paired counterparts, we embed real-world
driving clips (AI-Hub) of South Korea into MORAI SIM [ 8 ] , a digital twin simulator where HD map-based road network and buildings for two urban districts, Sangam and Pangyo of the same country, together with a library of vehicle assets are available.
As shown in Fig. 2 , the following three steps are conducted: (1) real-to-simulator coordinate conversion, (2) real-vehicle-to-virtual-asset mapping, and (3) sensor pose estimation that closely aligns both the geometry and appearance of real images and rendered counterparts.

南韩的驾驶剪辑机(AI-Hub)可进入MORAI SIM[8],这是一款以HD地图为基础的数字双相模拟器,该模拟器可提供同一国家Sangam和Pangyo两个城区的HD地图路网和建筑物以及车辆资产图书馆。

blocks.en: III-A 1 Locating the clip in the twin
blocks.zh: III-A 1 将剪辑定位于双胞胎

blocks.en:
We locate each recorded clip in the simulator by converting the ego vehicle’s GNSS trace into the map frame via UTM projection.
Since traces are acquired with high-accuracy RTK-DGPS, the converted trajectories align with the simulation environment without additional post-processing of the poses.
As the digital twin covers only a finite area, we discard any clip that contains even a single out-of-bounds frame.
To check the coverage of a clip, we extract lane-boundary nodes from the HD map and define each district’s spatial extent as a convex hull.
A clip is retained only if all of its frames fall within the hull.
blocks.zh:
我们通过UTM投影将自我飞行器的GNSS踪迹转换成地图框,
由于踪迹是用高精度的RTK-DGPS来获取的,所转换的轨迹会与模拟环境相配合而无需额外的后处理外形.
由于数码双胞胎只覆盖一个有限度的区域,我们丢弃任何包含哪怕一个出界框的片段.
为了检查剪辑的覆盖范围,我们从HD地图中提取出行道边界节点,并将每个区的空间范围定义为一个对流船体.
片段只有在其全部框架都属于船体时才被保留.

blocks.en: III-A 2 Replacing objects with library assets
blocks.zh: III-A 2 用图书馆资产替换对象

blocks.en:
After a clip is selected, we need to reproduce the dynamic objects (car, bus, and truck) of the scene inside the simulator.
The dynamic state of each annotated object transfers directly from the recording, but two questions remain: which simulator asset substitutes for the object, and how it is positioned.
First, we match the two by dimension and appearance.
For box dimensions, we take the per-axis maximum over the object’s tracked horizon, because a cuboid labeled from a single LiDAR sweep tends to underestimate a vehicle’s true extent due to occlusion and missing returns.
We rank the assets against the aggregated size by a weighted cost over length, width, and height.
Each axis is weighted by its normalized coefficient of variation (length: 0.35, width: 0.24, height: 0.41), prioritizing more discriminative dimensions.
The top-5 candidates are then re-ranked by appearance: SAM [ 18 ] -segmented crop of the object and each candidate asset are encoded into DINOv3 [ 19 ] features, and the candidate with the highest cosine similarity is kept. Second, we place assets by their near-corner positions.
Among the four BEV corners, the one nearest to the LiDAR is the only physical measurement: annotations are drawn by fitting L- or I-shaped returns anchored on that corner, even if they are parameterized by their centroids afterward.
We thus re-reference each object to its near corner before instantiating it in the simulator.
blocks.zh:
在选中一个剪辑后,我们需要复制模拟器内场景的动态物体(汽车,公交车和卡车).
每个注解对象的动态状态直接从录制中转移,但仍有两个问题:哪个模拟资产替代对象,以及它是如何定位的.
首先,我们按尺寸和外观来匹配两者。
对于盒子尺寸来说,我们把每轴最大值放在物体的跟踪地平线上,因为单次LiDAR扫射所标出的一个立方体往往由于被隔离和缺少返回而低估了车辆的真实程度.
我们按总规模按长度、宽度和高度的加权成本对资产进行排序。
每个轴都根据其常态变异系数(长:0.35,宽:0.24,高:0.41)进行加权,优先排列更分辨的维度.
后由外观重新排出前5名候选人: SAM [18]-分出对象的收成和每个候选资产被编码为DINOv3 [19] 特征,有最高同位素相似度的候选人被保留. 第二,我们把资产放在他们近角位置。
在四个BEV角中,离LiDAR最近的一个是唯一的物理测量: 注释是通过安装L-或I-形状的返回来绘制的,这些返回都固定在那个角上,即使它们之后被它们的百分行星参数化了.
因此,我们把每个物体重新提到它的近角,然后在模拟器中即时地看到它。

blocks.en: III-A 3 Recovering sensor poses
blocks.zh: III-A 3 回收传感器

blocks.en: AI-Hub provides a georeferenced ego trajectory and 3D bounding boxes with respect to LiDAR frame, together with the LiDAR-to-GNSS extrinsics. However, it does not specify where the sensors are located within the vehicle body, so the sensor extrinsics with respect to the vehicle must be recovered for simulation. To resolve this, our strategy is to anchor the simulator ego’s reference frame to the GNSS trajectory and deduce the remaining internal sensor placements via LiDAR data matching.
blocks.zh: AI-Hub提供了与LiDAR框架有关的地理参照自负轨迹和3D边框,以及LiDAR-至GNSS外观。 但是,它没有具体说明传感器在车辆体内的位置,因此,必须收回与车辆有关的传感器外接器进行模拟。 为了解决这个问题,我们的战略是通过LiDAR数据匹配,将模拟器的自我参照框架固定在全球导航卫星系统轨道上并推断出其余的内部传感器位置。

blocks.en: We initialize the simulator ego’s reference pose with the GNSS, transferring the horizontal placement (i.e., easting and northing in UTM) from the real data. Since the simulator grounds the vehicle to the terrain, GNSS height and tilt become redundant, leaving the LiDAR’s relative height and tilt unknown. With the simulator ego anchored to the GNSS, we determine the missing LiDAR-to-ego transform ( T ^ L ​ i ​ D ​ A ​ R E ​ g ​ o \hat{T}_{LiDAR}^{Ego} ) by minimizing the geometric discrepancy between real and simulated bounding boxes within the LiDAR frame: T ^ L ​ i ​ D ​ A ​ R E ​ g ​ o = arg ⁡ min T ​ 1 | ℳ ⁡ ( T ) | ​ ∑ ( i , i ′ ) ∈ ℳ ⁡ ( T ) ∑ j = 1 8 ‖ c i ​ j real − c i ′ ​ j sim ​ ( T ) ‖ 2 , \small\hat{T}_{LiDAR}^{Ego}\;=\;\arg\min_{T}\;\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}(T)|}\sum_{(i,i^{\prime})\in\mathcal{M}(T)}\sum_{j=1}^{8}\left\|c_{ij}^{\mathrm{real}}\;-\;c_{i^{\prime}j}^{\mathrm{sim}}(T)\right\|^{2}, (1) where c i ​ j real c_{ij}^{\mathrm{real}} is the j j -th corner of the i i -th real box in the LiDAR frame (fixed, from the dataset), c i ′ ​ j sim ​ ( T ) c_{i^{\prime}j}^{\mathrm{sim}}(T) is the corresponding corner of the simulated box i ′ i^{\prime} , and ℳ ⁡ ( T ) \mathcal{M}(T) denotes the real-to-simulated box correspondence. To optimize this objective, we set the initial condition of T T using the provided LiDAR-to-GNSS extrinsics. Furthermore, to define a plausible search boundary for the optimizer, we first fit a ground plane to the real point cloud via RANSAC. This provides a rough estimate of the LiDAR’s physical mounting height relative to the ground, establishing a valid bounding margin for the search space. Starting from this configuration, we iteratively optimize the full 6-DoF pose of T T using CMA-ES [ 20 ] . At each step, while the simulator ego remains fixed, updating the candidate LiDAR extrinsics repositions the surrounding vehicles within the simulator. This allows us to calculate the loss via Equation 1 , driving CMA-ES to propose the next LiDAR pose until convergence.

blocks.en:
Reconstruction in a digital twin paired with the real-world recording already provides a wealth of information for Sim2Real generator to leverage: a robust anchor for the placement of dynamic objects and a reference for static structures that every rendered view coherently shares.
In this sense, we hypothesize that minimal modifications to the generative network could be sufficient.
Consequently, the backbone is frozen throughout, and our modifications are focused on how the conditions are injected.

从这个意义上讲,我们假设对基因网络的最小修改可能足够。
因此,骨干一直被冻结,我们的修改侧重于如何注入条件。

blocks.en:
As summarized in Table I , we use one real and two synthetic datasets to demonstrate our approach. AI-Hub is a real driving dataset recorded on urban roads of South Korea with five surround-view cameras and one 128-channel LiDAR.
We divide it by regional coverage of a digital-twin simulator: a clip is in-twin ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{InTwin} ) if its GNSS trajectory lies inside the districts of digital-twin maps so that the virtual counterparts exist, and off-twin ( D O ​ f ​ f ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{OffTwin} ) otherwise. D A ​ l ​ l R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{All} denotes the two together.
Note that the official training and validation splits are frame-wise. Hence, we repartition AI-Hub driving clips in clip-wise manner for fair training of Sim2Real generator, fairly distributing dynamic objects in polar coordinate system with respect to the ego vehicle across splits.

SDEdit将合成RGB放入初始潜入t = 0.5 t_{0}=0.5,并留入深度和语义作为ControlNet分支.
另一方面,T2I-Adapter通过轻量级适配器传递出全部三个信号,学习率更小的为1×10−5 1\times 10×5}.

blocks.en: IV-B 3 3D Detectors
blocks.zh: 四-B 3 三维探测器

blocks.en: Downstream perception is measured with one monocular 3D detector, FCOS3D [ 23 ] , two multi-view 3D detectors, DETR3D [ 24 ] and PETR [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 下游感知用一个单光克立体探测器,FCOS3D [23],两个多视图立体探测器,DETR3D [24]和PETR [25]来测量.

blocks.en: IV-C Metrics
blocks.zh: 四-C计量

blocks.en:
The quality of generated images is measured with four complementary quantities.
PSNR and SSIM quantify pixel-level and structural agreement with the paired real frame. LPIPS measures distance to real image at deep-feature level. Lastly, FID compares the real and generated image sets at the distribution level. For downstream perception tasks, mAP and NDS [ 1 ] across car, bus, and truck classes are measured for 3D detection. Scores are evaluated on a D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{InTwin} validation set unless otherwise mentioned.
blocks.zh:
所生成图像的质量用四个相辅量来测量.
PSNR和SSIM的量化像素水平和结构上与配对的真帧一致. LPIPS在深层测量到真实图像的距离. 最后,FID比较了发行层的真实和生成的图像集. 对于下游的感知任务,mAP和NDS[1]通过汽车,公交车,和卡车等等级进行3D检测. 分数在 D In T w i R e a l D^{real}_{-InTwin} 验证集中进行评估, 除非另有提及。

blocks.en: V Experiments
blocks.zh: 五. 实验

blocks.en:
We first validate DT-R2S and DT-S2R separately in Section V-A .
Then, Section V-B asks whether the generated data can replace real counterparts for 3D detector training, and Section V-C studies the extent to which performance can be achieved without real target-region images by exploiting the digital-twin simulation and DT-R2S2R for the same region.
blocks.zh:
我们首先在V-A节中分别验证DT-R2S和DT-S2R。
然后,V-B节询问生成的数据是否能够取代3D探测器训练的真正对等数据,而V-C节则通过利用数字双相模拟和DT-R2S2R来研究在没有真实的目标区域图像的情况下实现性能的程度.

blocks.en: V-A Design Choices for DT-R2S2R
blocks.zh: DT-R2S2R的V-A设计选择

blocks.en: V-A 1 DT-R2S: scene reconstruction and sensor alignment
blocks.zh: V-A 1 DT-R2S:场景重建和传感器对接

blocks.en:
Table II isolates each stage of Section III-A2 and III-A3 on the raw reconstruction.
2D IoU is the image-space IoU between real and simulated cuboids, each projected onto the camera in which the simulated box is largest.
3D Corner Error is the mean distance over all corners of real and asset 3D boxes.
blocks.zh:
表二将关于原始重建的第三-A2和三-A3节的各个阶段单独列出。
2D IoU是真实和模拟立方体之间的图像-空间 IoU,每个被投射到模拟盒最大的相机上.

blocks.en:
The baseline—per-axis-max dimension aggregation with near-corner placement and the box-corner pose estimate—reaches 57.5 IoU and 0.581 m corner error. Appearance re-ranking trades a marginal amount of geometric fit for visual similarity (56.7, 0.632 m).
This could be explained as the visually closest asset need not be the dimensionally closest one among candidates with near-tied dimensions, and corner error conflates that mismatch with pose error.
The two remaining stages recover and surpass the baseline on all metrics. Ground-plane refinement raises IoU to 59.4. Clustering per-clip estimates into one transform per calibration group then gives the best scores throughout (60.4, 0.565 m), indicating the importance of a proper strategy to address per-clip pose noise.
Nevertheless, precision remains bounded by the finite asset catalog, underscoring the need for automated asset reconstruction from sensor data as a key enabler of scaling.
blocks.zh:
基线 -- -- 每轴 -- -- 最大尺寸的集合,加上近角器的放置和箱 -- -- 角器的估算值 -- -- 达到57.5 IoU和0.581米角错误。 外观再排位交易了几何量的边际,适合视觉相似度(56.7,0.632米).
这可以解释为,视界最接近的资产不一定是具有近乎尺寸的候选者中最接近的资产,而角出错则与构成错误的错配。
其余两个阶段恢复并超过了所有指标的基准。 地上飞机的改进将IoU提升到59.4. 将每克的估计数组合成每个校准组的一次变换,然后给出整个(60.4,0.565米)的最佳分数,表明处理每克的噪声的适当策略的重要性.
尽管如此,精确度仍以有限资产目录为界,突出表明需要从传感器数据中自动进行资产重建,作为缩小规模的关键手段。

blocks.en: V-A 2 DT-S2R: how the rendered view is used for paired Sim2Real training
blocks.zh: V-A 2 DT-S2R: 成对 Sim2 Real 训练时如何使用所提供的视图

blocks.en: Despite the sophisticated design for geometrically paired reconstruction, there exists a non-negligible visual domain gap to the real counterparts, coming from the limitation of the rendering pipeline. To address this, we additionally employ Sim2Real translation and evaluate it across three families — signal-processing, GAN, and diffusion. As presented in Table III , diffusion-based methods generally produce more realistic results than other methods. Based on the observation, we develop our DT-S2R (Stage1) upon the frozen diffusion backbone with ControlNet. For comparison, we also vary the injection mechanism of rendered RGB across two configurations: SDEdit and T2I-Adapter.
blocks.zh: 尽管几何对接重建设计十分精密,但从渲染管的局限性,仍存在着不可忽略的视觉域间隙到真实对等. 为了解决这一问题,我们额外使用Sim2Real翻译,并在三个家庭——信号处理、GAN和传播——进行评估。 如表三所示,基于传播的方法通常比其他方法产生更现实的结果。 根据观察,我们在ControlNet的冷冻扩散主干上开发了我们的DT-S2R(Stage1). 为了进行比较,我们还在SDEdit和T2I-Adapter两个配置上,对制成的RGB的注入机制进行了不同.

blocks.en:
SDEdit injects it as an initial latent, reaching 57.2 FID. T2I-Adapter, on the other hand, passes it through a lightweight adapter, presenting 22.1. Lastly, DT-S2R (Stage1) that uses residual conditioning branches for RGB reports 13.5, the better score over compared mechanisms, and the same holds for PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
Fig. 5 shows where each mechanism differs from the target.
SDEdit holds the road network and the geometry of the conditioning render closely, but the appearance of the simulator stays visible in its output.
T2I-Adapter keeps the global layout but loses thin structures such as lane markings.
Further training Stage1 with cross-view blocks leads to the proposed DT-S2R (Stage2), reporting the best structural similarity and fidelity on each metric in table.
blocks.zh:
SDedit将它作为初始潜入,达到57.2 FID. T2I-Adapter则通过轻量级适配器传递,呈现出22.1. 最后,DT-S2R(Stage1)在RGB报告13.5中使用了剩余条件分支,比机制得分更好,PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS也是如此。
图5显示每种机制与目标的不同之处。
SDEdit持有路网和调节器的几何能紧密地渲染,但模拟器的外观在输出中保持可见.
T2I-Adapter保持了全局布局,但失去了道道标等细小的结构.
进一步的培训阶段1带有交叉视图块,导致拟议中的DT-S2R(Stage2)报告表格中每个衡量标准的最佳结构相似性和忠诚性。

blocks.en:
It is worth noting that the behavior of SDEdit is one end of a trade-off.
Because it alters the conditioning RGB conservatively, the rendered structure remains after translation, leading to a lower chance of semantic flipping. This characteristic would make SDEdit more suitable as a training data engine for dense perception tasks such as segmentation, where pixel-level alignment between the generated labels and translated images is essential.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,SDedit的行为是取舍的一端.
因为它保守地改变了RGB的调制,所提供结构在翻译后仍然保留,导致语义翻转的可能性更低. 这一特性会使SDEdit更适合作为训练数据引擎,用于分解等密集感知任务,其中生成的标签和被翻译的图像之间的像素级对接至关重要.

blocks.en: V-A 3 Do real-world-trained detectors read the generated frames as they read real ones?
blocks.zh: 五A类 3 真实世界训练的探测器读取生成的帧时是否读取真实的帧?

blocks.en:
Image-quality metrics state how similar two images look, not whether a perception model reads them the same way.
We therefore comprehensively run one mono-view and two multiview detectors trained on AI-Hub ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{InTwin} ) over DT-R2S ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l ​ 2 ​ S ​ i ​ m D^{Real2Sim}_{InTwin} ) and DT-S2R ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} ) outputs, respectively.
We then score their predictions against the original real ground truth in Table IV .
Note that the scores show the disagreement accumulating two error sources, the geometry misalignment from the scene-recovery step and appearance gap from the translation step.

blocks.en:
The reconstruction on its own already recovers 47.5–57.6% of the mAP that the same detectors obtain on the corresponding real frames.
The Sim2Real step further raises mAP to near 70% for DETR3D and NDS over 76% for all detectors, demonstrating the fidelity of data generated by the entire pipeline DT-R2S2R against original real scenes.

blocks.en: V-B 1 Is the Sim2Real step necessary?
blocks.zh: 维-B 1 是否需要Sim2Real步骤?

blocks.en:
We first explore whether the Sim2Real step brings performance gains to 3D detector training.
Table V (a) shows the performance of FCOS3D trained solely on the synthetic data with and without DT-S2R.
The same scenes after the translation step yield a higher mAP by nearly a factor of 5 than raw reconstruction, indicating that reproducing geometries in the simulator alone does not produce trainable data due to the large visual domain gap.
blocks.zh:
我们首先探索Sim2Real步骤是否为3D探测器训练带来性能收益.
表五(a)显示FCOS3D完全通过DT-S2R和非DT-S2R合成数据培训的性能。
翻译步骤后相同的场景产生的mAP比原始重建几乎高出了5倍,表明光是模拟器中再生出相地美图,由于视觉域漏洞较大,无法生成可训练数据.

blocks.en: V-B 2 How far does the generated data substitute for real data of the same scene?
blocks.zh: 维-B 2 生成的数据能在多大程度上取代同一场景的真实数据?

blocks.en:
In Table VI we vary the ratio of real to the paired synthetic data, holding the total number of training frames fixed during FCOS3D training.
As intuitively expected, in general, the performance declines gradually as real data are withdrawn on both mAP and NDS.
However, even when all real data are retracted, the detector retains 90.28% and 93.23% of its oracle mAP and NDS, respectively.
This demonstrates that the high-quality reproduction of real-world scenes by DT-R2S2R yields valid synthetic proxies, serving as a viable alternative to real-world data for 3D detector training.
blocks.zh:
在表六中,我们改变了真实数据与配对合成数据的比例,保留了在FCOS3D培训期间固定的培训框架总数。
一般来说,正如直觉所预期的那样,随着mAP和NDS上的真实数据被撤回,性能逐渐下降.
然而,即使所有真实数据被收回,探测器仍分别保留了甲骨文mAP和NDS的90.28%和93.23%.
这表明DT-R2S2R对现实世界场景的高质量再现产生了有效的合成代词,成为3D探测器训练现实世界数据的可行替代品.

blocks.en: V-B 3 Does the generated data also augment?
blocks.zh: 维-B 3 生成的数据是否也增加了?

blocks.en: As shown in Table V (b), adding the generated copies to the full real data raises mAP from 37.59 to 38.60, even though the two sets depict fundamentally the same scenes. This is attributed to DT-S2R which maintains the dynamic-object placement but resynthesizes the color, texture, and lighting. In other words, it supplies the variation that the real data do not contain.
blocks.zh: 如表五(b)所显示的,将生成的拷贝添加到完整的真实数据中,使mAP从37.59升至38.60,尽管这两套基本描绘的是相同的场景. 这归因于DT-S2R,它维持了动态对象定位,但重新合成了颜色、纹理和照明. 换句话说,它提供了真实数据不包含的变异.

blocks.en: V-C Enriching Scene-Level Diversity with Novel Synthetic Sim2Real Data
blocks.zh: V-C 用小说合成 Sim2 Real 数据丰富场景级多样性

blocks.en: V-C 1 How Close Can Expanded Scene Diversity Bring Us to the Real-Data Oracle?
blocks.zh: V-C 1 扩展场景多样性能把我们带到真正的数据甲骨文?

blocks.en:
In this section, we evaluate the feasibility of deploying a 3D detection system to the target region without directly utilizing any target-region real images for detector training.
To this end, we investigate the effect of combining two synthetic datasets: reconstructed clips ( D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} ) and ADC25 ( D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} ), a purely simulator-generated dataset using the digital twin and trained DT-S2R.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们评价在目标区域部署3D探测系统而不直接利用任何目标区域真实图像进行探测器训练的可行性。
为此,我们调查合并两个合成数据集的效果:被重建的片段(D I n T i s i m) 2个 R e a l D^{-Sim2Real}_{-InTwin})和ADC25 (D A C 25 S i m 2. R e a l^{-Sim2Real}_{-ADC25}),是使用数字双子并训练有素的DT-S2R的纯模拟所生成的数据集.

blocks.en: Table VII summarizes the efficacy of our generated data. Training on D A ​ D ​ C ​ 25 S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{ADC25} alone achieves 29.39 and 34.41 mAP on DETR3D and PETR, which are close to 61% of oracle performance. Additionally, when combined with D I ​ n ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n S ​ i ​ m ​ 2 ​ R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Sim2Real}_{InTwin} , mAP of DETR3D increases further to 45.50, 93.18% of oracle score, and the same trend can be observed for PETR, reporting 88.84% of oracle performance. Importantly, when compared against the practical real-world baseline trained on out-of-target region data ( D O ​ f ​ f ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{OffTwin} ), it outperforms the baseline by +5.52 mAP on DETR3D and achieves a comparable score on PETR. Although the non-negligible performance gaps of 3.33 mAP for DETR3D and 6.16 mAP for PETR to the oracle scores still remain, these results show that our digital twin-grounded synthetic data can effectively substitute for real-world data collected and labeled for the target region.

blocks.en: V-C 2 Can Off-Target Real Data Complement Synthetic Diversity to Reach Oracle Performance?
blocks.zh: V-C 2 超目标真实数据能补充合成多样性来达到甲骨文性能吗?.

blocks.en:
To bridge the remaining gap, we additionally incorporate out-of-target real data into our full synthetic datasets.
This joint training achieves 51.02 mAP on DETR3D and 55.79 mAP on PETR, exceeding the target-region real oracle by +2.19 mAP and +0.56 mAP, respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了弥合所剩差距,我们还将目标之外的实际数据纳入我们的全面合成数据集。
这项联合培训实现了DETR3D上的51.02 mAP和PETR上的55.79 mAP,分别以+2.19 mAP和+0.56 mAP超过了目标区域真正的甲骨文.

blocks.en:
In a distance-based breakdown analysis, the practical value of this joint training can be clearly observed.
In a mid-to-long range (30–50m) where stable detection is pivotal for robust downstream prediction and planning, the practical baseline trained on D O ​ f ​ f ​ T ​ w ​ i ​ n R ​ e ​ a ​ l D^{Real}_{OffTwin} yields 23.56 (78.9% oracle) on DETR3D and 32.31 mAP (85.16% oracle) on PETR.
Crucially, these notable gaps to the oracle are alleviated when also employing our full synthetic suite. Especially for DETR3D, the mAP gain of +9.99 is observed, surpassing the oracle by +3.69.
blocks.zh:
在远程分解分析中,可以清楚地观察到这种联合培训的实际价值。
在稳定探测对强力下游预测和规划至关重要的中到长范围(30-50m)中,在DETR3D和32.31 mAP(85.16% oracle)上对D o f f t i n R e i D-Real-OffTwin)进行实际基线培训。
关键是,在使用我们完整的合成套房时,这些对神谕的显著差距得到缓解。 特别是对于DETR3D来说,观察到了+9.99的mAP增益,以+3.69超过了甲骨文.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigated the value of georeferenced digital twins as a scalable, annotation-free training data source for camera-based 3D perception in a novel deployment scenario.
By conditioning a diffusion model on rendered views, depth, and semantics from digital twin reconstructions, our DT-R2S2R framework synthesizes photorealistic driving data across both reconstructed scenes and novel simulator scenarios.
Our experimental findings demonstrate that 3D detectors trained solely on this synthetic data recover a substantial portion of full performance of a target-region real-data oracle, and further outperform that oracle when co-trained with existing out-of-region real datasets. Where digital twin infrastructure is accessible, DT-R2S2R provides a practical and cost-effective pathway to scale 3D perception systems, which mitigates the expense of manual on-site data collection and annotation.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们调查了地理参照数字双胞胎作为一种可伸缩的,无注释的训练数据源在新颖的部署情景中用于相机3D感知的价值.
我们的DT-R2S2R框架通过对从数字双子重建中渲染的视角、深度和语义的传播模型进行调节,将光现实主义驱动数据综合到重建的场景和新作模拟情景。
我们的实验结论表明,只受过这种合成数据培训的3D探测器恢复了目标区域实际数据甲骨文的很大一部分全部性能,并在与现有的区域外实际数据集共同训练时,进一步超过了甲骨文。 DT-R2S2R为数字双向基础设施提供了一种实用和成本效益高的途径,以扩大三维感知系统的规模,从而减少了人工现场数据收集和注释的费用。
